title: The Orbit of Station Meridian
author: Lena Coldharbour
blurb: Cyrus Underhill, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
